themeDescription: Putting it all together, annual review, goals

days.title: Year in Review Part 1 - What You Learned About AI
days.learning_objective: Reflect on everything you learned about AI this year—its capabilities, limitations, and responsible use.

days.title: Year in Review Part 2 - What You Learned About Yourself
days.learning_objective: Reflect on the personal growth and self-awareness gained through this year's learning journey.

days.title: Year in Review Part 3 - What You Learned About Learning
days.learning_objective: Reflect on the meta-learning skills developed—how you've become a better learner.

days.title: Connecting the Dots - How Everything Relates
days.learning_objective: Synthesize connections between all the year's topics and themes.

days.title: Your Knowledge Map - Visualizing What You Know
days.learning_objective: Create a personal knowledge map showing the landscape of your learning.

days.title: Gaps and Growth - Where You Want to Go Next
days.learning_objective: Identify gaps in knowledge and skills, and set priorities for future learning.

days.title: Celebrating Progress - Acknowledging How Far You've Come
days.learning_objective: Celebrate the progress made this year and recognize your growth.

days.title: Sharing What You Learned - Teaching Others
days.learning_objective: Share your learning with others, reinforcing understanding through teaching.

days.title: Gratitude for Teachers - Thanking Those Who Helped
days.learning_objective: Express gratitude to the teachers, mentors, and supporters who helped you learn.

days.title: You as a Teacher - How You've Helped Others
days.learning_objective: Recognize the ways you've taught and supported others' learning.

days.title: The Learning Community - We Learn Together
days.learning_objective: Appreciate the community of learners who shared this journey with you.

days.title: AI as Learning Partner - Reflecting on the Relationship
days.learning_objective: Reflect on how AI has served as a learning partner this year and how to improve that relationship.

days.title: Human as Learner - What Makes You Unique
days.learning_objective: Celebrate your uniqueness as a human learner with gifts AI cannot replicate.

days.title: Setting Next Year's Goals - What Will You Learn?
days.learning_objective: Set clear, meaningful learning goals for the coming year.

days.title: Creating Your Learning Plan - Structuring the Year Ahead
days.learning_objective: Develop a concrete learning plan with milestones and checkpoints.

days.title: Building Learning Habits - Daily Practices
days.learning_objective: Design daily learning habits that compound into significant growth.

days.title: Learning Accountability - Staying on Track
days.learning_objective: Create accountability structures to follow through on learning commitments.

days.title: Learning Joy - Rediscovering the Love of Learning
days.learning_objective: Reconnect with the intrinsic joy of learning and discovery.

days.title: The Compound Effect - Small Daily Learning Adds Up
days.learning_objective: Appreciate how small daily learning efforts compound into transformative growth.

days.title: Your Learning Identity - Who Are You as a Learner?
days.learning_objective: Clarify your identity as a learner and the role learning plays in your life.

days.title: Staying Curious - Keeping the Spark Alive
days.learning_objective: Nurture curiosity as the eternal flame that powers lifelong learning.

days.title: Embracing Uncertainty - Learning to Not Know
days.learning_objective: Find comfort in not knowing as the starting point for all new learning.

days.title: Taking Risks - Trying New Things
days.learning_objective: Commit to taking learning risks—trying new subjects, skills, and approaches.

days.title: Rest and Learning - The Importance of Breaks
days.learning_objective: Honor rest as essential to learning—consolidation, creativity, and renewal.

days.title: Celebrating Others - Learning from Peers' Journeys
days.learning_objective: Celebrate fellow learners and draw inspiration from their growth.

days.title: Looking Forward - What Excites You?
days.learning_objective: Identify what excites you about the future and the learning it will bring.

days.title: Looking Inward - Who Are You Becoming?
days.learning_objective: Reflect on the person you're becoming through learning.

days.title: Looking Outward - How Can You Contribute?
days.learning_objective: Consider how your learning enables you to contribute to others and the world.

days.title: The Learning Life - Making Learning Your Lifestyle
days.learning_objective: Commit to learning as a lifestyle, integrated into every aspect of life.

days.title: Final Wisdom - What You'll Carry Forward
days.learning_objective: Distill the essential wisdom from this year that you'll carry into the future.

days.title: The Next Chapter - Your Journey Continues
days.learning_objective: Close this chapter knowing that learning never ends—your journey continues forever.
